backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user profiles with access control plus event CRUD storage and validation.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to implementing files, components, and test coverage.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing each frontend file’s purpose across layout, pages, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global style layer defining OKLCH color tokens and dark theme variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: App root configuring auth flow, theme provider, and TanStack Router routes for all pages.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Renders an access denied message with a login button.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button handling Internet Identity login/logout with query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal prompting first‑time users to submit their name and saving the profile.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppBran: Branding component showing app icon and title.
frontend/src/components/empty/EmptyState: Reusable empty-state display with illustration, text, and optional action button.
frontend/src/components/events/DeleteEve: A confirmation dialog for deleting an event, showing event name and disabling actions while processing.
frontend/src/components/events/EventForm: A form for creating or editing events with validation, voice input support, and detailed field handling.
frontend/src/components/events/VoiceInpu: A button that toggles speech recognition, displays live transcripts, and parses recognized text into form data.
Page layout wrapper providing background styling, sync status bar, and bottom navigation.
frontend/src/components/layout/BottomNav: A fixed bottom navigation bar that highlights the active route and navigates between core app pages.
frontend/src/components/status/SyncStatu: Displays online/offline status and pending sync count, hiding itself when fully synced online.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useConnectivity.ts: Tracks online status and pending changes using browser events.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity login, logout, and identity state using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for loading and mutating profiles and events through the backend actor.
Custom React hook wrapping browser SpeechRecognition to manage listening state and produce transcripts.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles plus CSS variables for theme colors and global styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React Query and Internet Identity provider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/AddEventPage.tsx: Page for creating events with autosaved drafts and form submission to backend.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarPage.tsx: Calendar view showing events by day with indicators, month navigation, and date selection.
frontend/src/pages/EditEventPage.tsx: Page to load an existing event, populate a form, and submit updates back to the backend.
frontend/src/pages/EventDetailsPage.tsx: Event details view showing full event info with actions to edit, delete, or mark completed.
frontend/src/pages/HomeDashboard.tsx: Dashboard summarizing key event metrics like counts, revenue, and upcoming events.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentsPage.tsx: Displays pending payment events with month filtering, totals, and navigation to event details.
frontend/src/utils/bookingParser.ts: Parses free‑text booking messages to extract event details like type, date, time, organizer, payments, and requirements.
frontend/src/utils/date.ts: Provides helper functions for formatting dates, generating month calendars, and navigating months.
frontend/src/utils/eventAdapter.ts: Converts backend event data to form-friendly structures and back, handling metadata, requirements, and amounts.
frontend/src/utils/eventMetrics.ts: Computes event metrics such as upcoming events, monthly stats, and pending payments using date-based filters.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Manages URL and session-stored parameters, including retrieval, persistence, and safe removal from hashes.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, layout, animations, and enabling plugins for typography, queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes the app’s current state, features, architecture, and image requirements for a mobile-first sports event manager. Includes UI plans, event/payment workflows, calendar behavior, and notification rules.
